name: Dedham Plaza
summary: Dedham Plaza is a community shopping center located on Providence Highway in Dedham, Massachusetts, managed by Federal Realty Investment Trust. The open-air center serves the greater Boston area with convenient access to national retailers and local businesses, maintaining strong customer satisfaction with over 1,200 reviews.
demographics: Dedham Plaza serves a diverse suburban Boston demographic with a strong middle to upper-middle class customer base from Dedham and surrounding communities including Westwood, Norwood, and West Roxbury. The trade area attracts families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+, with a mix of young professionals, established families, and empty nesters. Shoppers are drawn to the center's convenient location on Route 1 (Providence Highway) and its mix of everyday necessities and specialty retailers, with typical visitors seeking value-oriented shopping combined with quality national brands.
description: Dedham Plaza is a well-established community shopping center strategically located at 747 Providence Highway in Dedham, Massachusetts, one of Boston's historic suburban communities. Owned and operated by Federal Realty Investment Trust, a premier national retail real estate company known for its high-quality shopping destinations, Dedham Plaza serves as a convenient retail hub for residents throughout the South Shore and Metro West regions. The center benefits from its prime location along the busy Route 1 corridor, offering excellent visibility and accessibility to the greater Boston metropolitan area. With daily operating hours from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, Dedham Plaza provides a comfortable open-air shopping experience featuring a carefully curated mix of national retailers, local businesses, and service providers that cater to the everyday needs of the surrounding communities. The center maintains a strong reputation with a 4.2-star rating from over 1,200 customer reviews, reflecting its commitment to providing quality retail options and a pleasant shopping environment for families and individuals throughout the region.
